semiconductor_relevance: High — Hebei Synlight Semiconductor Co., Ltd. specializes in the production of silicon carbide substrates, which are critical for various semiconductor applications.
summary: Hebei Synlight Semiconductor Co., Ltd. focuses on the research, development, and manufacturing of silicon carbide (SiC) single crystal substrates. The company aims to provide high-quality substrates for applications in power electronics and other advanced semiconductor technologies.
capabilities: Production of conductive silicon carbide single-crystal substrates
Manufacturing of high-purity semi-insulating silicon carbide substrates
Development of optical-grade high-transmittance silicon carbide wafers
Mass production of 8-inch and development of 10-inch and 12-inch substrates
technical_expertise: Crystal growth techniques for silicon carbide
Quality management systems in semiconductor manufacturing

regional_presence.China: Hebei Synlight operates multiple factories in China, including Baoding and Laiyuan, with plans for expansion.
